newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia March trade surplus 1.75 bln rgt. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Malaysia March trade surplus 1.75 bln rgt. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]

text.p: Malaysia had a trade surplus of 1.75 billion ringgit in March against a revised surplus of 368.5 million in February, the Statistics Department said on Friday.
Malaysia had previously reported a trade surplus of 367.2 million ringgit in February. The January balance was a deficit of 102.9 million ringgit.

Financial markets had speculated that the government would announce a surplus for March. The timing of the report caught investors off-guard, as it has been typically issued in the last week of the month.

The department said the improvement was due to the combined results of higher exports, which jumped 2.8 percent (corrects from "28 percent") to 18.680 billion ringgit and a 4.1 percent drop in imports to 16.929 billion ringgit, the national Bernama news agency reported.
From January to March 1997, Malaysia posted a trade surplus of 2.016 billion ringgit compared with a deficit of 1.357 billion ringgit in the similar 1996 period.
